_comment: Limits for scripts/perf-watch/perf_watch.py: how far a number may go up before the perf watch opens a `performance` issue. A report, never a gate: crossing one never fails a build. The first rule whose `match` (fnmatch) fits a metric's name applies. A number is over when it is more than `percent` above its reference AND more than `min_delta` above it, in the metric's unit, so a tiny number moving by a little doesn't count. Counts are deterministic and get tight limits; footprint and idle CPU move between runs of the same build on a CI machine and get looser ones. See docs/perf-watch.md.
